summary: Example EXOS-API group_vars uses httpapi, community.network.exos, user, vaulted password and proxy_env; remove proxy_env for direct access or use https_proxy for HTTPS proxies.
questions: What group_vars do I need for EXOS-API?
How do I use a web proxy with EXOS-API?

answer_card.title: EXOS-API group_vars example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
ansible_connection: ansible.netcommon.httpapi
ansible_network_os: community.network.exos
ansible_user: myuser
ansible_password: !vault...
proxy_env:
  http_proxy: http://proxy.example.com:8080
```
Remove `proxy_env` for direct access; use `https_proxy` for an HTTPS proxy.
